sprite_sequence.text: No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet surge of panicked embarrassment and self-reproach, worried that starting the term late has already gone wrong.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: I only meant to look at the time...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed, quietly trying to excuse herself while inwardly panicking about being late on the very first day.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is startled and flustered, with a brief burst of panic at the sudden newspapers hitting her face, though she’s too reserved to react loudly for long.
sprite_sequence.label: surprised

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels flustered and embarrassed by the string of mishaps, but is trying to stay composed and push through the morning without panicking.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a sudden surge of anxious relief and urgency, desperately hoping to catch the bus while trying to stay composed despite her flustered embarrassment.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels a quiet, sinking mix of embarrassment and resignation, trying to accept the bad luck with a small, controlled calm rather than openly panicking.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Good morning. I'm sorry for... this shape.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is mortified and flustered, but trying to recover her composure with quiet politeness and a faintly self-conscious sense of humor.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: I haven't ridden one in a while.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels shy and mildly anxious, with a quiet self-consciousness about her lack of practice and a small, restrained hope that she can still manage.
sprite_sequence.label: shy

sprite_sequence.text: Maybe... maybe I can still make homeroom.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is quietly anxious but cautiously hopeful, trying to steady herself after a string of humiliating mishaps and focus on the small chance that she can still recover the morning.
sprite_sequence.label: anxious

sprite_sequence.text: Why is there a daikon in the basket...
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted, quietly incredulous, and a little defeated, but is still trying to stay composed and matter-of-fact despite the absurd string of mishaps.
sprite_sequence.label: sad

sprite_sequence.text: ...This was supposed to be a good start.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels quietly crushed and embarrassed, with a small, resigned sadness at how the morning has spiraled despite her trying so hard to begin well.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: I ironed everything. I checked everything. I really tried.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels quietly crushed and unfairly defeated, with a fragile mix of embarrassment, frustration, and hurt pride as she tries to reassure herself that she did her best.
sprite_sequence.label: sad

sprite_sequence.text: I'm fine. Just... losing to vegetables.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She is embarrassed and near tears, but trying to cover her frustration with dry, self-deprecating humor and a quiet determination to stay composed.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed and overwhelmed, but also quietly relieved and grateful that someone is helping her after such a humiliating morning.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Right. Running sounds simpler than cycling.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels embarrassed but relieved, quietly amused by the absurdity, and cautiously encouraged by his practical help.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels exhausted and relieved, with a faint, embarrassed sense of triumph that she managed to arrive at all despite the morning’s chaos.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed

sprite_sequence.text: Please don't tell anyone about the daikon.
sprite_sequence.emotion_description: She feels shyly embarrassed and vulnerable, but also relieved enough to make a small, self-protective joke as she asks for discretion.
sprite_sequence.label: embarrassed
